summary: Large installations finish their runs reliably and are ready for the next one.

fixes.title: Large runs finish instead of being stopped
fixes.text: At the end of a run on a large installation, the pages now catch up in steps that report progress, so they always reach the new data.

fixes.title: Waiting updates install right after a run
fixes.text: An update that waits for a run is now installed right after the run ends, before any other run starts.

fixes.title: The next run is no longer held back
fixes.text: A run that ended while its runner was stopped is now closed at once.
